newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NationsBank price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NationsBank price target raised.

text.p: -- Gerard Klauer Mattison reiterated its buy rating on NationsBank Corp and raised its one-year share price target to $125 from $115.

-- A massive share buyback program should support the stock, it said. Gerard Klauer said it expects NationsBank to repurchase about 39 million shares, or more than 10 percent of its post-merger shares, in 1997.
-- Gerard Klauer sees NationsBank as the most undervalued stock in its bank group.
-- NationsBank's merger with Boatmen's Bancshares Inc is expected to close January 7.
-- NationBank's share price rose 1-7/8 to 101-1/4 in morning trading.
